screen.scope_reason: The paper applies SPC rules to forecasted semiconductor measurements, assigning risk zones to monitor the production process and flag potential problems proactively.
The paper compares and extends control-chart monitoring schemes for detecting isolated and persistent defects in 3D-printed objects, using explicit Phase I process-monitoring terms.
The paper studies measurement-error effects on multivariate CUSUM-CoDa control charts, evaluating run-length performance and illustrating manufacturing-process monitoring.
